item_weight_check.name: item_weight_check

item_alias_code_check.name: item_alias_code_check

kit_code_check.name: kit_code_check
kit_code_check.value: char_length("kit"."code") between 2 and 30 and "kit"."code" = upper("kit"."code") and "kit"."code" = btrim("kit"."code") and "kit"."code" !~ '[,*+ -]{2}' and "kit"."code" !~ '^[,*+ -]|[,*+ -]$'

supplier_tax_identity_check.name: supplier_tax_identity_check

supplier_anonymized_check.name: supplier_anonymized_check

        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'VALUE' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" = 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."value_delta" <> 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."unit_cost" is null)

repair_order_text_check.name: repair_order_text_check

production_bom_note_check.name: production_bom_note_check

production_order_cancelled_check.name: production_order_cancelled_check
production_order_cancelled_check.value: ("production_order"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("production_order"."cancel_reason" is not null and "production_order"."cancelled_by" is not null and "production_order"."cancelled_at" is not null)

production_order_posted_check.name: production_order_posted_check
production_order_posted_check.value: ("production_order"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("production_order"."posted_by" is not null and "production_order"."posted_at" is not null and "production_order"."posting_id" is not null)

production_order_text_check.name: production_order_text_check

production_order_line_figures_check.name: production_order_line_figures_check

stocktake_line_count_check.value: ("stocktake_line"."counted_at" is null and "stocktake_line"."counted_quantity" is null and "stocktake_line"."book_quantity" is null) or ("stocktake_line"."counted_at" is not null and "stocktake_line"."counted_quantity" is not null and "stocktake_line"."book_quantity" is not null and "stocktake_line"."counted_quantity" >= 0)

contract_delivery_batch_note_check.name: contract_delivery_batch_note_check

return_photo_shape_check.name: return_photo_shape_check

buy_back_note_text_check.name: buy_back_note_text_check
